title: proto-forge configuration (e2e template)
description: Merged over the built-in strict defaults and any ~/.config/proto-forge/config.json. Run `pnpm config:show` to see what is actually in force and where each value came from. Anything omitted keeps its strict default — this file only records deviations.

policy.description: Documentation of intent. Enforcement comes from gates[].mode and waivers[], not from this field.

gates.description: Per-gate settings. Tightening is always allowed. Relaxing a mandatory gate (the MANDATORY_GATES list in scripts/config.mjs — registry, stub, snapshot, status) below "error" additionally requires a live waivers[] entry — without one, config:check fails AND the gate runs at "error" regardless of what is written here.

requireApproval.description: Outward-facing effects an operator must confirm interactively. None ship with this template.

protectedPaths.description: Glob patterns an agent hook refuses to edit — the byte-pinned gate corpus (validator included), the locks, the append-only prompt log.

freezeThresholds.description: Refuse edits that would relax a gate mode or switch a lint rule off. Overridable for one command with PROTO_FORGE_ALLOW_THRESHOLD_EDIT=1.

selfHealing.description: Tiered self-healing for a red `pnpm verify` (NFR-19): layered, bounded and on the record. `pnpm heal` regenerates derivations from the healing registry first (tier 1), dispatches a bounded agent pass second (tier 2, consent-gated below), and escalates third. Hard-stop gates never enter any tier, and every pass writes a .prompts/ entry before it acts.

enabled.description: Tier 1: deterministic regenerations of what is derived — in this template only the STATUS block (quality:report); the case registries are decisions and stay out. Derivations only; no floor moves and no consent act runs.

maxPasses.description: Upper bound on mechanical passes per heal run. A healing loop without a bound is a loop.

enabled.description: Standing, reviewed consent for the UNATTENDED agent tier — the autoPropagate form: committing true here IS the approval, visible in review, unlike a flag typed once. It consents to the bounded fix loop and nothing else: hard-stop gates never enter, guard hooks keep freezing floors, and the gate-failure rules ride along in every dispatched prompt.

maxPasses.description: Upper bound on agent passes per heal run. A healing loop without a bound is a loop.

commandEnv.description: Name of the env var holding the agent runner executable (default PROTO_FORGE_HEAL_AGENT; when the var is unset heal falls back to `claude -p … --permission-mode acceptEdits`). Never a command string in this file — the tokenEnv pattern.

enabled.description: Consent for heal.yml to run after a red verify in CI (tier 1 only there — the workflow exports no agent env). The workflow additionally requires the repository variable HEAL_ENABLED == 'true'; both doors are explicit acts.

waivers.description: The only way to relax a mandatory gate. Each entry expires; after that the gate enforces again on its own.

reason.description: What the relaxation buys and why the risk is acceptable.

adr.description: Number of an ADR that exists in docs/adr/.

mode.description: error = fails the build. warn = prints findings and passes. off = does not enforce.
